categories.title: Watchtower
categories.info: Once climbed, watchtowers act as Fast Travel points.

categories.title: TM
categories.info: Use TMs to teach Pokémon new compatible moves. Craft them at Poké Centers using the indicated materials, which you can get by defeating their corresponding Wild Pokémon.

categories.title: Medicine
categories.info: Medicines are items that can be used to heal your Pokémon inside and outside of battle, or to cure status effects.

categories.title: Poké Ball
categories.info: Pokéballs are used to capture wild Pokémon. Different Pokéball types can increase your catch chance!

categories.title: Treasure
categories.info: Treasures are items with no actual use, but they can be sold at shops for a high price.

categories.title: Trainer
categories.info: Defeat other Trainers for prize money. Their pokemon's levels, and reward you get for defeating them, may change based on your level.

categories.title: Legendary Pokémon
categories.info: Legendary Pokémon can only be fought once, so make sure to capture them!

categories.title: Tera Pokémon
categories.info:
Tera Pokémon are like typical Wild Pokémon, who start the battle Terastallized. Lower their HP to break the Tera state and catch them! 

Tera Pokémon have a chance to respawn every day at midnight.
